column1: # CrowdStrike — Income Tax Provision & Deferred Tax
# Source: SEC EDGAR — XBRL companyfacts (10-K, as reported) + cited 10-K text. USD unless noted.
# Deferred tax: large deferred tax assets from net operating loss carryforwards (NOLs), stock-based compensation and R&D credits, partially offset by a valuation allowance.
# Tax provision is modest relative to pre-tax results because U.S. losses are sheltered by NOLs; expense is driven largely by foreign jurisdictions.
